verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant is a fair question for a card-issuing API platform, since it could ship an in-dashboard or in-docs AI assistant. The evidence shows only an official MCP server that lets the user's own external editor AI (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot) search docs and call the API. That belongs to the separate MCP-server story and is not an assistant built into Lithic itself, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.
